space_name: Uniqueness methodology and R&F with hashing
topic: Unique traffic calculation methodology for mall analytics
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on updating the unique traffic (uniques) methodology for a Mall analytics release. A key problem identified was that aggregating uniques over long periods and across multiple locations caused an increase in displayed unique counts, with several vendors generating anomalies.

The proposed fix involves defining a sample of 'trusted vendors'—those exhibiting stable behavior and adhering to Wi-Fi standards when generating MAC addresses—to ensure correct calculation of unique traffic. This methodology was previously released for Total Traffic but needs to be applied specifically to the Mall analytics context.
decisions: The trusted vendor definition approach will be used for calculating uniques in the Mall analytics release.
